_comment: Public roster of microwonk personas for the ARG. Safe to commit. Private keys live in config/microwonk-keys.env (gitignored). Addresses are populated by script/microwonk/generate_wallets.sh.

treasury.label: ARG Treasury — campaign float funding all microwonks + proposer + resolver
treasury.notes: On testnet: dedicated EOA, key in config/microwonk-keys.env. On mainnet: Safe; replenisher uses the key here but holds <$100 equivalent.

proposer.label: Resonance Exchange — in-universe broadcast & wager proposer
proposer.notes: Parent account that posts new wagers via Proposition Service. Holds gas ETH plus Proposer bond budget.

resolver.label: Resolution Service — delegated resolver for all microwonk wagers
resolver.notes: Not a Twitter persona. Signs resolve()/retract()/expire() transactions based on decisions JSON.
